--- 
Mr.Deepak M. Gupte a/w Mr.Aniket Punjabi for the petitioners.
Mr.R.S. Pawar, Agp for the respondent nos.1, 3 & 4.
Mr.K.M. Lahnkar h/f Mr.S.R. Ganbavale for the respondent no.2-PCMC.

---
 Coram : R.D. Dhanuka &
 Gauri Godse, Jj.

The Petitioners seek a writ of mandamus against the Respondent No.3 to pay the
compensation for acquisition of the land bearing Survey No.99/13, Cts 6198, Village
Rahatani, Taluka Haveli, District Pune at the market rate.
2.  It is the case of the Petitioners that though the Petitioners are the owners of the said land bearing Survey No.99/13, no notice was served to the Petitioners at any point of time.
According to the said Petitioners, the said land was not even included in any of the notification.
3. Mr.Pawar, learned AGP for the State invited our attention to the averments made in paragraph 10 of the affidavit-in-reply filed by the Respondent Nos.1, 3 & 4.

Upon raising a query as to whether any amount ppn 2 19.wp-15009.22.doc of compensation in the sum of Rs.2,00,65,361/- is payable under the said award to any of the claimants, learned AGP states that there is no other claimant mentioned in the said award.

4. In view of these circumstances, we direct the Respondent Nos.1, 3 & 4 to deposit the said amount of Rs.2,00,65,361/- in this Court within three weeks from today with intimation to the Petitioners'
Kishor Ramchandra Punjabi And Anr vs The Land Acquisition Officer Special ... on 18 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138192548/
1 advocate.

sentences.text: 5. State Government to file an affidavit and to deal with the issue referred by the Petitioners and more particularly, whether the land of the Petitioners is acquired or not and whether the said land corresponds to the land bearing Survey No.99/13 as reflected at page 94 forming part of the award and annexed to the affidavit-in-reply.
6. Place the matter on board for 'Admission' on 14th June 2023.

GAURI GODSE, J. R.D. DHANUKA, J.
